system.summary: One-part Polish syllabary-nomenclator of about 2,200 dotted number groups in alphabetical order (two runs), with a null band 1775-1788.
system.notes: Second alphabetical run from about 1870; letters under groups mark variants; a framed 4000/9933 second table in two December letters is not read.

prior_solution.where: Clear texts of 103 of the 106 despatches in AGAD ZbPop 419 and 417 (fair copies or the cabinet's decipherments, signed Deboli, with reception notes); used by Łojek 1962 and Rolnik 2025

conditions.human_role: Pasted the catalogue task page; no other input.

solution.what: AGAD letter lists (ZbPop17.xml, 419, 417, 420, 4) and scans on agadd2; key units 444/451/453/454 not online.
Zielińska & Danilczyk Deboli 1782 introduction (cabinet decipherments in AKP 265), Rolnik 2025, web search: no decipherment of ZbPop 17 itself.
Clear series ZbPop 419 as the plaintext: dates pair for 100 of 106 cipher despatches.
6 Jan 1789 cipher (760 groups) and its clear text transcribed.
Hand alignment of the closing paragraph: lokacya = 623 461 2150 twice, aby = 1900 three times, warunkami/warunkow.
One-part syllabary in alphabetical order, second run from about 1870.
align.py: DP alignment of cipher groups to 0-10 clear letters with an alphabetical-order cost and iterated anchors; 1, 3, 8, then 11 pairs (630 anchors).
Groups 1775-1788 align to nothing (1786: 93 of 94): a null band.
LM gap-filling inside alphabetical brackets on the held-out 18 Dec letter: 5-8 of 171 hidden groups exact; dropped.
Key from 7 pairs, 18 Dec decoded blind: 95.6% of groups valued, 91.4% of decoded letters in the order of the real clear text.
Clear texts of 22, 25, 29 Dec found misfiled in ZbPop 417 (catalogued 1788).
25 Mar addition read by hand from the key (95.5%); 14 Dec first half checked; 10 May decoded by key, not yet checked by hand.

parts.label: 103 despatches with a clear text in ZbPop 419/417
parts.basis: Clear texts of the same despatches; eleven checked group by group against their cipher.

parts.label: 3 despatches with no clear text (25 Mar, 10 May, 14 Dec 1789)
parts.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
parts.basis: Key rebuilt by aligning eleven cipher despatches with their clear texts in the same fonds, then applied.

outcome.method_basis: The clear series ZbPop 419/417 holds the plaintext of 103 despatches; the key rebuilt from eleven of those pairs reads the three that have none.
outcome.fraction_read_source: targets/deboli1789/reading/*.tsv (read.py), cipher tokens of the three unpaired despatches; c042 not yet hand-checked
